provenance.method: Owned A selected one free Kakao Friends Classic static sticker in the owned A/B direct chat, typed a synthetic caption into the composer under the sticker preview and tapped Send once. B's scoped read-only SYNCMSG probe recorded the single resulting chat log: its type, message and attachment keys and values. A's and B's official clients both rendered that one log as the sticker followed by a text bubble. Paths are synthetic; the message is the synthetic caption that was sent.
